summary: Jefferies Financial Group filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a $1,000-per-note offering of Senior Autocallable Barrier Notes due October 21, 2031, linked to the worst-performing of the Nasdaq-100, Russell 2000 and S&P 500 indices. Notes are senior unsecured obligations under the Series A Global Medium-Term Notes program, priced October 16, 2026 for issue October 21, 2026, with annual call observation beginning October 18, 2027 and a call premium reflecting at least roughly 15.30% per annum. This is a routine structured-note takedown, not a special situation; watch index path dependency and credit risk.
